column3: A thread run that fails transiently resumes once after 30 s: interrupted, or model_error whose last error pi-ai calls retryable and #104's FINAL (a 4xx other than 408/425/429, credit balance) does not exclude; never a stall, overtime, cancel, deterministic error, archived thread or capped feature. State on xin.thread (resume pending, resumedRun done); fired by an orchestrator clock timer whose due times are kept in memory from the commit stream
column4: A resume resends the whole context, so a deterministic error would cost up to 7 more requests that cannot succeed; pi-ai's classifier plus the shared FINAL pattern keep one definition with #104. Stalls are excluded because the watchdog beats only per response or tool call, so a stream longer than 2 min reads as stalled and a resume would rerun a healthy answer (XIN-32 review). A clock timer instead of a sleeping task keeps the cost at one alarm, and the in-memory index means an arm reads no thread document
